message.villagerciv.expand.shape_kept: %s: "We have grown once on such a charter and cannot again. But we will keep this one: the great wall we build as a city shall be %s. We begin it the day we are a city with our wall finished."
message.villagerciv.expand.shape_same: %s: "Our next wall is to be %s already. We begin it the day we are a city with our wall finished."
message.villagerciv.expand.not_a_city: %s: "A Grand Charter is for a city whose wall is finished. We are not there yet."
message.villagerciv.expand.done.grand: %s: "It is settled. Our land reaches twice as far, and round it we raise a great wall, broad enough to walk."
message.villagerciv.expand.too_small: %s: "We are not a town yet, and there is room left within our bounds. A charter to grow is for later."
message.villagerciv.expand.already: %s: "We have grown as far as any charter can take us."
message.villagerciv.expand.surveying: %s: "We will walk the land beyond the wall and see what it holds."
message.villagerciv.expand.busy: The land is being surveyed already.
message.villagerciv.expand.done: %s: "It is settled. We build out through the gates, and raise a second wall, of stone, round it all."
message.villagerciv.expand.done.open: %s: "It is settled. The land beyond is ours to build on."
policy.villagerciv.none.hint: Without a plan the settlement lives on, but grows into nothing more. Give the Leader a Development Plan; it can follow several.
policy.villagerciv.industry.hint: Better mining and felling. On its own, less room is kept for growth.
policy.villagerciv.military.hint: A stronger General, more guards, and a wall raised before it is needed. On its own, fewer children.
message.villagerciv.plan.doubt.agrarian: %s: "Mind, the land here is poor for farming. It will be slow."
message.villagerciv.plan.doubt.industry: %s: "Mind, there is little stone in sight here. It will be slow."
message.villagerciv.request.fulfilled: %s thanks you: the %s it asked for is all there.
message.villagerciv.request.expired: %s's request for %s has lapsed. They carry on without it.
message.villagerciv.request.no_longer_ne: %s no longer needs the %s it asked for: they managed.
message.villagerciv.found.no_expedition: You have no expedition to settle. Recruit villagers first.
message.villagerciv.found.too_few: A settlement needs at least %s founders.
message.villagerciv.found.not_travelling: Your expedition must be travelling with you.
message.villagerciv.found.territory_take: This land already belongs to another settlement.
message.villagerciv.found.near_village: Too close to a village. Lead your people further away.
message.villagerciv.found.wrong_dimensio: A settlement can only be founded in the Overworld.
message.villagerciv.found.surveying: %s walks the land and looks it over…
message.villagerciv.found.blocked: Something is in the way of the Town Center now.
message.villagerciv.found.expired: That survey is out of date. Use the charter again.
message.villagerciv.found.founded: %s has been founded! Your people will take it from here.
screen.villagerciv.site.title: Site Survey
screen.villagerciv.site.good: "A good place. We can make a home here."
screen.villagerciv.site.fair: "It will do, though it will not be easy."
screen.villagerciv.site.poor: "A hard place to live. We will struggle here."
screen.villagerciv.site.problem.not_on_l: "We cannot build a home on this."
screen.villagerciv.site.problem.no_room: "There is no level ground here, not even for a camp."
screen.villagerciv.site.problem.not_surv: "I could not see enough of the land. Come closer and ask again."
screen.villagerciv.settlement.building.n: The settlement is full. It works on, but grows no further.
screen.villagerciv.settlement.commodity_: For building. Brought in by lumberjacks.
For building. Brought up by miners.
For tools and metalwork. Found in the mine.
All tools in store, of every kind.
screen.villagerciv.settlement.tool_enoug: Everyone who needs one has one.
screen.villagerciv.settlement.tool_unuse: Nobody is doing this work right now.
screen.villagerciv.settlement.tool_use.h: Farmers sow and reap 1.5× faster (1.75× with a Blacksmith at work).
screen.villagerciv.settlement.tool_use.a: Lumberjacks plant and fell 1.5× faster (1.75× with a Blacksmith at work).
screen.villagerciv.settlement.tool_use.p: Miners dig 1.5× faster (1.75× with a Blacksmith at work).
screen.villagerciv.settlement.tool_use.s: Levelling ground and digging wells go 2× faster.
The General strikes twice as hard.
screen.villagerciv.settlement.give_hint: To give goods or tools, hold them and use them on the Town Center (without sneaking). The right tool makes a worker half again as fast.
message.villagerciv.settlement.town_cent: The people of %s have raised their Town Center again.
message.villagerciv.settlement.born: A child, %s, was born in %s. (%s citizens)
message.villagerciv.settlement.arrived: %s has come to live in %s. (%s citizens)
message.villagerciv.settlement.no_store_: %s has no free ground left for a main storehouse, not even for the hall alone. It will look again when a new street is laid.
message.villagerciv.settlement.declined: %s has dwindled and is a %s again.
message.villagerciv.librarian.keeps: %s keeps %s. Bring a book and %s emeralds, and it is yours. (Sneak to hear who keeps what.)
message.villagerciv.librarian.none: %s has no enchantment to keep yet.
message.villagerciv.settle.joined: %s of your followers moved into %s. (%s citizens)
message.villagerciv.settle.nobody: You have no followers to settle here.
message.villagerciv.settle.hint: Your followers can move in here: sneak and use the Town Center with both hands empty.
message.villagerciv.recruit.unseen: %s is with you, but out of sight: more citizens than this machine is set to show at once (/villagerciv preset).
message.villagerciv.recruit.refused: The villager is not willing to leave. Ask again another day.
message.villagerciv.recruit.cooldown: This villager already said no. Ask again in about %s min.
message.villagerciv.expedition.camped: Your expedition makes camp and waits for you.
message.villagerciv.expedition.following: Your expedition is following you again.
message.villagerciv.expedition.betrayed: The others saw what you did. They trust you less.
message.villagerciv.expedition.hungry: Your expedition has run out of food. Hand food to any member.
message.villagerciv.expedition.disbanded: You send your expedition home. They settle back into village life.
message.villagerciv.citizen.left: %s has lost faith in you and gone home.
screen.villagerciv.offer.title: Recruitment Offer
screen.villagerciv.offer.night: It is night, but the scroll is binding
screen.villagerciv.offer.refusal: A villager shown the scroll always comes.
screen.villagerciv.offer.cooldown: Already said no. Ask again in about %s min.
screen.villagerciv.expedition.title: Your Expedition
screen.villagerciv.expedition.food_toolt: Each member eats one meal a day.
screen.villagerciv.expedition.starving: Out of food! Hand food to any member.
screen.villagerciv.expedition.feed_hint: To feed the expedition, hold food and use it on any member (sneak to hand over the whole stack).
